$comment: Placeholder arguments with a DECLARED value source. Each entry names the row and, per placeholder token, where that value comes from at run time. verify-gate-manifest reads this table directly (the same pattern as client-exceptions.json): a declared token is no longer a no-placeholders observation, and an UNDECLARED one still is - a live gap with no register entry fails the registry.

gate-27.<platform version>: the platform version the run targets; release.yml passes it as PLATFORM_VERSION to the validate action, which forwards --platform-version

gate-29.<plane home>: the plane home directory the run audits; the CI job supplies it as the checkout home and forwards --home

gate-33.reason: composite-cell: its table row names six commands, so it has no single argv to run - the meta-gate own detail names the two acceptable resolutions (split the cell, or add an argv with a value source), and this declaration takes the second
